title: 营养与健康机遇
summary: 评估食品公司通过健康营养产品满足市场需求的能力与产品组合。

blocks.content: This document provides essential information on the components of the Opportunities in Nutrition & Health Key Issue to enable users of ESG Ratings to understand how our outputs are determined. Opportunities in Nutrition & Health is a Key Issue in the Social Pillar of the MSCI ESG Ratings model. Companies are evaluated on their positioning to meet market demand for products with improved nutritional or health profiles.
blocks.content_cn: 本文件介绍营养与健康机遇关键议题各组成部分的核心信息，帮助 ESG 评级使用者理解评估结果的形成方式。营养与健康机遇属于 MSCI ESG 评级模型社会支柱下的关键议题。公司评估考察其满足营养或健康特征得到改善的产品市场需求的布局与能力。

blocks.content: For additional details on the MSCI ESG Ratings Model, refer to Section 2, Data, ratings and scores, of "ESG Ratings Methodology."
blocks.content_cn: 有关 MSCI ESG 评级模型的更多信息，参见《ESG 评级方法论》第 2 节“数据、评级与得分”。

sections.title_en: Opportunities associated with this Key Issue
sections.title_cn: 与本关键议题相关的机遇

blocks.content: \- Increased revenue from growing demand for nutritional and healthier products.
blocks.content_cn: • 营养及更健康产品需求增长带来收入增加。

blocks.content: \- Reputational damage and fines resulting from controversies related to false marketing claims.
blocks.content_cn: • 虚假营销声明相关争议导致声誉损害及罚款。

sections.title_en: Opportunities in Nutrition & Health Key Issue Score
sections.title_cn: 营养与健康机遇关键议题得分

blocks.content: The Opportunities in Nutrition & Health Key Issue Score evaluates the company's level of exposure to, and management of, opportunities on this Key Issue. The Key Issue Score is based on the Exposure Score and the Management Score using the formula below. The Exposure Score and the Management Score are combined such the Exposure Score determines the weight placed on the Management Score, ranging from $50\%$ (when the Exposure Score is equal to zero) to $100\%$ (when the Exposure Score is equal to 10).
blocks.content_cn: 营养与健康机遇关键议题得分评估公司在此议题上的机遇敞口及机遇管理水平。该得分根据敞口得分与管理得分，按下列公式计算。二者的结合方式为：敞口得分决定管理得分的权重，范围从 $50\%$（敞口得分为零）至 $100\%$（敞口得分为 10）。

blocks.content:
$$
K I _ {i} = \left(\left(\frac {E X P _ {i}}{2 0} +. 5\right) \times M G M T _ {i}\right) + \left(\left(. 5 - \frac {E X P _ {i}}{2 0}\right) \times 5\right)
$$
Where:
blocks.content_cn: 其中：

blocks.content: \- $KI_{i}$ is the Key Issue Score for company $i$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $KI_{i}$ 为公司 $i$ 的关键议题得分。

blocks.content: \- $EXP_{i}$ is the Exposure Score for company $i$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $EXP_{i}$ 为公司 $i$ 的风险敞口得分。

blocks.content: \- $MGMT_{i}$ is the Management Score for company $i$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $MGMT_{i}$ 为公司 $i$ 的管理得分。

sections.title_en: Opportunities in Nutrition & Health Management Score
sections.title_cn: 营养与健康机遇管理得分

blocks.content: The Opportunities in Nutrition & Health Management score is based on the weighted average of the relevant indicator scores, modified by controversies. Default indicator weights may be adjusted for the relevance of business activities; an indicator has zero weight when the company has no exposure to the activity it covers.
blocks.content_cn: 管理得分按适用指标得分加权平均，再按争议事件调整。指标采用默认权重，并可根据公司业务活动的相关性调整；公司对某指标覆盖的业务活动没有敞口时，该指标权重为零。

blocks.content: $$MGMT_i = \sum_j Indicator\_Score_{j,i} \times Indicator\_Weight_{j,i}$$

MGMT_i denotes the Management score excluding controversies; j denotes an applicable indicator and i denotes the company. Component scores aggregate indicator scores using weights scaled within the component.
blocks.content_cn: MGMT_i为争议调整前的管理得分；j表示适用指标，i表示公司。组件得分按组件内重新归一化后的指标权重汇总，不应默认将各组件等权平均。

sections.title_en: • In-house innovation capacity to develop healthier products.
sections.title_cn: • 开发更健康产品的内部创新能力。

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company has resources dedicated to developing healthier and more natural products. Leading practice is to have dedicated research centers and staff to develop healthier products.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否投入专门资源开发更健康、更天然的产品。领先实践是设立专门研究中心和人员开展此类开发。

sections.title_en: • Strategy to develop natural and healthy products.
sections.title_cn: • 开发天然及健康产品的战略。

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company has a strategy to further develop natural and healthy products
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否制定进一步开发天然及健康产品的战略。

sections.title_en: - Extent of programs to reduce artificial ingredients in food products.
sections.title_cn: • 减少食品人工成分计划的覆盖程度。

blocks.content: Definition: The estimated share of revenues generated from food and beverage products that contain less or no artificial ingredients (e.g., preservatives, colorings, aspartame) or less or no controversial ingredients (e.g., antibiotics).
blocks.content_cn: 定义：估算来自较少或不含人工成分（例如防腐剂、色素、阿斯巴甜），或较少或不含争议成分（例如抗生素）的食品饮料产品的收入占比。

sections.title_en: - Extent of programs to reduce portion size.
sections.title_cn: • 缩小份量计划的覆盖程度。

blocks.content: Definition: The estimated share of revenues generated from products reformulated with reduced portions.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：估算来自通过调整而减小份量的产品的收入占比。

sections.title_en: - Extent of programs to reduce sugar in food products.
sections.title_cn: • 减少食品糖含量计划的覆盖程度。

blocks.content: Definition: The estimated share of revenues generated from food and beverage products reformulated with less sugar.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：估算来自调整配方后糖含量较低的食品饮料产品的收入占比。

blocks.content: A controversy deduction ranging from 0 to 5 points is subtracted from the overall Management Score, based on the severity and type of controversies facing the company on this Key Issue. The following categories of controversies are used in the assessment:
blocks.content_cn: 根据公司在此关键议题上所涉争议的严重程度及类型，从总体管理得分中扣减 0—5 分。评估采用以下争议类别：

blocks.content: \- False marketing controversies.
blocks.content_cn: • 虚假营销争议。

blocks.content: For more details on how controversies are included in the MSCI ESG Ratings model, refer to Section 3.3.2, Controversies cases, of "ESG Ratings Methodology."
blocks.content_cn: 关于争议如何纳入 MSCI ESG 评级模型的更多信息，参见《ESG 评级方法论》第 3.3.2 节“争议案例”。

sections.title_en: Opportunities in Nutrition & Health Exposure Score
sections.title_cn: 营养与健康机遇风险敞口得分

blocks.content: The Opportunities in Nutrition & Health Exposure Score evaluates the company's exposure to opportunities on this Key Issue. It is based on the Business and Geographic Exposure Scores. The Geographic Exposure Score functions as a multiplier on the Business Exposure Score, with an impact ranging from -50% to +50%. The Business and Geographic Exposure Scores are scored on a 0-10 scale, with 10 corresponding to the highest opportunity and 0 corresponding to the lowest opportunity. Refer to Section 3.2, Analyzing risk exposure, of “ESG Ratings Methodology” for additional details. The following formula is used in the Exposure Score calculation:
blocks.content_cn: 营养与健康机遇敞口得分评估公司在此关键议题上的机遇敞口，以业务和地域敞口得分为基础。地域敞口得分作为业务敞口得分的乘数，影响范围为 -50% 至 +50%。两项得分均采用 0—10 分制，10 分对应最高机遇水平，0 分对应最低机遇水平。详情参见《ESG 评级方法论》第 3.2 节“风险敞口分析”。敞口得分按以下公式计算：

blocks.content:
$$
E X P _ {O N H, i} = B U S _ {O N H, i} (1 + 0. 1 \bigl (G E O _ {O N H, i} - 5 \bigr))
$$
Where:
blocks.content_cn: 其中：

blocks.content: \- $EXP_{ONH,i}$ is the Opportunities in Nutrition & Health Exposure Score of company i.
blocks.content_cn: • $EXP_{ONH,i}$ 为公司 i 的营养与健康机遇敞口得分。

blocks.content: \- $BUS_{ONH,i}$ is the Business Exposure Score of company $i$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $BUS_{ONH,i}$ 为公司 $i$ 的业务敞口得分。

blocks.content: \- $GEO_{ONH,i}$ is the Geographic Exposure Score of company $i$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $GEO_{ONH,i}$ 为公司 $i$ 的地域敞口得分。

blocks.content: The Calorie Score is based on the recommended calorie intake (in kilocalories per day) for a given food category from the EAT-Lancet Commission Summary Report. The higher the number of calories recommended, the higher the Calorie Score for a given food category, varying from 0 to 10.
blocks.content_cn: 热量得分以 EAT—《柳叶刀》委员会摘要报告中某类食物的推荐热量摄入量为基础，单位为千卡／天。推荐热量越高，该食物类别热量得分越高，范围为 0—10 分。

blocks.content: The Macronutrient Score is based on the recommended macronutrient intake (in grams per day) for a given food category from the EAT-Lancet Commission Summary Report. The higher the amount of macronutrients recommended, the higher the Macronutrient Score for a given food category, varying from 0 to 10.
blocks.content_cn: 宏量营养素得分以 EAT—《柳叶刀》委员会摘要报告中某类食物的推荐宏量营养素摄入量为基础，单位为克／天。推荐摄入量越高，该食物类别宏量营养素得分越高，范围为 0—10 分。

blocks.content: Business activities are mapped to food categories to which they cater. A higher score reflects a higher opportunity, given the higher intake recommendations.
blocks.content_cn: 业务活动映射至其所服务的食物类别。推荐摄入量越高，得分越高，反映更高机遇。

blocks.content: The Geographic Segment Exposure score is determined by the following formula:

blocks.content:
$$
G S E _ {O N H, c} = F R H _ {O N H, c} \left(S U G _ {O N H, c} + H W S _ {O N H, c} + H W R _ {O N H, c} + 1\right)
$$
Where:
blocks.content_cn: 其中：

blocks.content: \- $FRH_{ONH,c}$ is the FReSH Report Score of country $c$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $FRH_{ONH,c}$ 为国家 $c$ 的可持续发展与健康食品改革报告得分。

blocks.content: \- $SUG_{ONH,c}$ is the sugar tax multiplier of country $c$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $SUG_{ONH,c}$ 为国家 $c$ 的糖税乘数。

blocks.content: \- $HWS_{ONH,c}$ is the health and wellness market size by population multiplier of country c.
blocks.content_cn: • $HWS_{ONH,c}$ 为国家 c 按人口计的健康与保健市场规模乘数。

blocks.content: \- $HWR_{ONH,c}$ is the health and wellness market size growth rate multiplier of country c.
blocks.content_cn: • $HWR_{ONH,c}$ 为国家 c 的健康与保健市场规模增长率乘数。

blocks.content: The FReSH Report Score is derived from a qualitative assessment of the relevance of consumption behaviors, trends and food preferences by region, taken from the World Business Council for Sustainable Development's Food Reform for Sustainability and Health [FReSH] insights report on “Consumption Behavior and Trends.”
blocks.content_cn: 可持续发展与健康食品改革（FReSH）报告得分，通过定性评估各地区消费行为、趋势及食物偏好的相关性确定，来源为世界可持续发展工商理事会 FReSH《消费行为与趋势》洞察报告。

blocks.content: The sugar tax multiplier, equal to 5%, is applied if a country has a sugar tax.
blocks.content_cn: 若一国征收糖税，则应用 5% 的糖税乘数。

blocks.content: The health and wellness market size by population multiplier is variable (2%-10%) and is determined by the health and wellness market size in a given country relative to its total population.
blocks.content_cn: 按人口计的健康与保健市场规模乘数可变，范围为 2%—10%，根据该国健康与保健市场规模相对于总人口的水平确定。

blocks.content: The health and wellness market size growth rate multiplier is variable (2%-10%) and is determined by the annual growth rate of the health and wellness market size in a given country.
blocks.content_cn: 健康与保健市场规模增长率乘数可变，范围为 2%—10%，根据该国健康与保健市场规模的年增长率确定。

blocks.content: The following sources are used to determine the Opportunities in Nutrition & Health Exposure Score:
blocks.content_cn: 确定营养与健康机遇风险敞口得分时使用以下来源：

blocks.content: The EAT-Lancet Commission on Food, Planet, Health, Sustainable Food Systems: Summary Report; World Business Council for Sustainable Development's FReSH insights report on “Consumption Behavior and Trends;” Obesity Evidence Hub; the Organic Trade Association’s consumption estimates data for organic packaged foods and beverages; Refinitiv; MSCI ESG Research; company disclosures.
blocks.content_cn: EAT—《柳叶刀》食品、星球与健康委员会《可持续食物系统摘要报告》；世界可持续发展工商理事会 FReSH《消费行为与趋势》洞察报告；肥胖证据中心；有机贸易协会关于有机包装食品和饮料的消费估算数据；路孚特；MSCI ESG 研究；公司披露。
